Architectural overview

Problem & architectural thesis

Small desktop applications often couple UI forms directly to storage files, making workflows brittle to extend. TunedIn separates domain models, enums, and ticketing services into a shared .NET 8 core library beneath the WinForms screens.

Control flow

  1. Propose / InputWinForms Ticketing Screens

    Captures user actions across login, ticket-pack selection, cart management, and checkout screens.

  3. Domain ContractISDS309.Core Domain & Services

    Isolates domain entities, status enums, and cart/payment service logic from form event handlers.

  5. Commit / OutputReceipts & Delimited File Storage

    Generates order receipts and writes state to comma-delimited text files (with explicitly documented reliability gaps).

Key tradeoff & failure mode

Built as an earlier desktop systems project and published with its known README limitations intact: login does not check credentials against stored user records, state is not auto-saved on exit, the main loop lacks top-level error handling, and the directory was not kept under Git version control.
